raw_segments.text: Flulan, it is not well done, Mark you now, to take the tales out of my mouth, ere it
is made and finished. I speak but in the figures and comparisons of it. As Alexander killed
his friend Kletus, being in his ails and his cups, so also Harry Monmouth, being in his
right wits and his good judgments, turned away the fat knight with the great belly doublet.
He was full of jests and gipes and knaveries and mocks. I have forgot his name."
